title.narrative: Support to the Guatemalan HR Ombudsman (PDH)

description.narrative: Insatsen avser att stärka PDH och fokuserar på dess strategiska plan för att fullfölja institutionens mandat.
This contribution aims to strengthen the Human Rights Ombudsman, and is focused on its strategic plan in order to fulfil its mandate.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: During 2016 the Guatemalan Ombudsman Office conducted an important effort for improving the implementation of the program. The strengthened capacities of Regional Offices and Headquarters was crucial in order to increase the number of denounces effectively attended, and the quality of the interventions.
Especially relevant was the participation of the Ombudsman as part of the Technical Secretariat for drafting the proposal for the Constitutional Reform on Justice Sector.
The Swedish contribution helped to improve the protection of Human Rights in Guatemala, via the consolidation of the advances made in the strengthening of the Guatemalan Ombudsman Office.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
